scripts.db:migrate: docker compose run --rm api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: docker compose run --rm api python -m scripts.seed
scripts.contracts:generate: docker compose run --rm api python -m scripts.export_openapi /contracts/openapi.json
scripts.format:check: npm --workspace apps/web run format:check && docker compose run --rm api ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/web run lint && docker compose run --rm api ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/web run typecheck && npm --workspace tests/e2e run typecheck && docker compose run --rm api mypy app
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace apps/web run test && docker compose run --rm api pytest -m 'not integration'
scripts.test:integration: docker compose run --rm api pytest -m integration
